productName: AIA Voluntary Health Insurance Prime Scheme

trends.whatProductOffers: Lets the client choose between three annual deductible amounts in HKD or USD - HKD0 / USD0, HKD16,000 / USD2,000 or HKD25,000 / USD3,125 - under a VHIS-certified reimbursement plan.
exclusionsOrConditions: Only three deductible levels are shown on the product page.
The product page lists certain certification numbers as Not available for New Application.
Premium, benefit limits and exclusions were not available in the fetched copy.

trends.notesForReviewer: The assigned brochure slug is shared with the Flexi Scheme, so the 6,000-character brochure extract describes a different product and could not be used. The product page returned only the certification and deductible table; no premium, limits, room level or exclusions were available. Treat as weak evidence.
